title: Pharmacometric Analysis of Givinostat to Support Individualized Dosing Recommendations in Pediatric Patients with Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy
summary: Pharmacometric modeling of givinostat in pediatric DMD supported a simplified 4-band weight-based dosing regimen without compromising efficacy or safety.

### See how model-informed approaches simplify dosing in rare disease programs


Pediatric and rare disease programs rarely allow the dose-ranging that conventional development assumes. Population PK/PD modeling and simulation let sponsors test regimen alternatives in silico, reducing dosing complexity, supporting weight-band simplification, and defending exposure and safety margins with regulators. Certara’s pharmacometrics team applies these methods across every phase, from first-in-human through label-enabling analyses.
